components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default high-commitment action on a light surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 3.25rem; position: relative; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #1c1c1a); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-ink, #1c1c1a); color: var(--color-linen, #f3f0e9); padding: 1.05rem 2.5rem; font-family: var(--font-label, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .16em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 400ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color 400ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: var(--color-umber, #51463d); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brass, #b79355); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action that fills with ink on intent.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 3.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #1c1c1a); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1c1a); padding: 1.05rem 2.5rem; font-family: var(--font-label, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .16em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 400ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color 400ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { background: var(--color-ink, #1c1c1a); color: var(--color-linen, #f3f0e9); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brass, #b79355); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Dark Outline Button
components.description: A light-outlined action for void and photographic fields.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { min-height: 3.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-linen, #f3f0e9); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-linen, #f3f0e9); padding: 1.05rem 2.5rem; font-family: var(--font-label, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .16em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 400ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color 400ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-dark:hover, .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { background: var(--color-linen, #f3f0e9); color: var(--color-void, #0e0d0c); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brass, #b79355); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-dark:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Service Row
components.description: A dense yet breathable service-and-price line for the booking catalog.
components.css: .ds-service-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto auto; align-items: baseline; gap: .8rem; min-height: 4.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-sand, #d8cdbd); color: var(--color-ink, #1c1c1a); padding: 1.25rem 0; font-family: var(--font-body, Georgia, serif); font-size: 1.08rem; line-height: 1.35; transition: background 350ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-service-row i { min-width: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--color-sand, #d8cdbd); transform: translateY(-.25rem); } .ds-service-row b, .ds-service-row em { font-family: var(--font-label, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: .6875rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-service-row em { color: var(--color-umber, #51463d); } .ds-service-row:hover { background: var(--color-alabaster, #faf9f6); }

components.name: Underlined Field
components.description: A quiet field that uses a brass underline to acknowledge focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .65rem; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1c1a); font-family: var(--font-label, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .18em; line-height: 1.2; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 3.25rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-sand, #d8cdbd); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1c1a); padding: .75rem 0; font-family: var(--font-body, Georgia, serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; letter-spacing: -.01em; outline: 0; transition: border-color 350ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--color-brass, #b79355); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brass, #b79355); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Disclosure
components.description: A ruled editorial disclosure with a brass plus mark.
components.html:
WHAT SHOULD I EXPECT?+

Clear, useful detail opens beneath the rule.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-sand, #d8cdbd); color: var(--color-ink, #1c1c1a); font-family: var(--font-body, Georgia, serif); } .ds-disclosure summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; min-height: 4rem; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-disclosure summary span { color: var(--color-brass, #b79355); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-disclosure[open] summary span { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-disclosure p { max-width: 68ch; margin: 0; padding: 0 2.5rem 1.5rem 0; color: var(--color-umber, #51463d); line-height: 1.65; } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brass, #b79355); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Compact Mobile Actions
components.css: .ds-mobile-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .8fr 1.2fr; border: 1px solid var(--color-sand, #d8cdbd); background: var(--color-linen, #f3f0e9); font-family: var(--font-label, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-mobile-actions a { display: inline-flex; min-height: 3.25rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--color-ink, #1c1c1a); text-decoration: none; } .ds-mobile-actions a + a { background: var(--color-ink, #1c1c1a); color: var(--color-linen, #f3f0e9); } .ds-mobile-actions a:hover, .ds-mobile-actions a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brass, #b79355); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-mobile-actions a:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

narrative.overview:
Casa D'Lucca is a high-touch Brazilian beauty house in Chicago: an editorial world of warm mineral paper, near-black rooms, antique-brass hairlines, and real salon imagery. Its sophistication comes from proportion, photography, and type—not generic luxury ornament. Brazilian modernist curves soften the system while Chicago Deco discipline gives it its vertical rhythm.

The experience is photographic and typographic, asymmetrical but composed. Service detail is deliberately dense enough to be useful, then opened up by generous blank space and long horizontal rules. The work, the people, and a clear route to booking lead; the interface stays quiet and factual around them.
keyCharacteristics: Warm mineral palette with void-black contrast and restrained brass signals.
Bodoni Moda display type over literary Lora body copy and compact Inter Tight labels.
12-column editorial composition on larger screens; six-column mobile composition with preserved asymmetry.
Real photography as the primary source of atmosphere and proof.
One controlled arch silhouette per viewport; hairline rules and vertical dividers provide the recurring geometry.

rules.name: The Brass Signal Rule
rules.body: Brass is a rule, focus, or active-state signal—not a broad decorative fill. Keep it visually scarce.

rules.name: The Mineral-Not-Clinical Rule
rules.body: Default to linen, alabaster, sand, ink, and umber. Avoid cool gray, blue-white, glossy black, or medical-interface color logic.

rules.name: The Three-Line Arrival Rule
rules.body: The home title remains exactly three lines: “Chicago’s / Brazilian beauty / destination.” Its line breaks are part of the composition.

rules.name: The Labels-Are-Tools Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase labels provide navigation and data precision; they do not compete with display headings for expressive weight.

rules.name: The Photograph Leads Rule
rules.body: Give a photograph room to establish each major section. Typography should align to, frame, or counterbalance it—not turn the image into a decorative card thumbnail.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce box shadows, glass blur, floating cards, or gradients. The sole gradient exception is the functional Home hero scrim.

rules.name: The One-Arch Rule
rules.body: Use no more than one arch motif within a viewport. Let it establish a moment of softness against the house's rules and rectangles.

dos: Do lead with real salon imagery and use it as evidence, atmosphere, and spatial counterweight.
Do use brass for hairlines, active underlines, focus, markers, and singular emphasis.
Do keep service information compact, ruled, and easy to scan; preserve price and duration prominence.
Do maintain the 12-column to six-column grid transition and the horizontal filmstrip behavior on mobile.
Do keep motion restrained, use the house easing, and reduce it to near-instant under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do keep the compact Call/Book system available on mobile and preserve visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't use generic salon card grids, pill buttons, oversized rounded corners, decorative icon tiles, glass effects, stock textures, or AI-generated imagery.
Don't use gradients except the single functional legibility scrim on the Home hero.
Don't turn brass into a dominant background color or add visual clutter through redundant decorative numerals.
Don't replace real routes, map directions, or financing recovery paths with loading-only or image-only states.
Don't use clinical, cold, or exaggerated luxury styling; the house is warm, specific, welcoming, expert, and sophisticated.
